subject: Whistic: service account justification + minimal evidence snapshot request
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@greenbridge.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: security@greenbridge.com
Date: 2028-03-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Whistic: service account minimal evidence ask

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick chat yesterday. We ran a short intake with our InfoSec team and they flagged one narrow request before we finish the Whistic profile: our procurement team needs a short justification and an evidence snapshot for the service account that Redwood will use to perform S3 presign uploads to our Whistic bucket.

Specifically they asked for: 1) the service account name and principal, 2) a brief justification of why this account needs persistent access vs ephemeral, and 3) a minimal evidence excerpt showing the ACL/policy (screenshot or PDF) plus confirmation of token rotation cadence.

We don't need a full SOC 2 artifact here — just the items above so we can clear the onboarding gate. Attached is our intake template for small vendors (one page). Can you send the requested snapshot and a one-paragraph justification?

Best,
Alex Ramos
Security Operations
GreenBridge Finance

Attachment: small-vendor-intake-template.pdf (application/pdf)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@greenbridge.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic: service account minimal evidence ask

Hi Alex — thanks, will do.

Quick answers upfront:
- Service account: redwood-whistic-uploader@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- Justification (summary): this account enables server-side presign uploads of evidence bundles and manifests from our ingestion pipeline to a customer-designated S3 bucket. Persistent principal is used because the ingestion pipeline runs on dedicated infra (reserved instances) and must attach signed presign URLs on delivery; we restrict scope and use short-lived presign tokens.

I'll pull the policy excerpt and a screenshot of the S3 bucket policy and token-rotation notes and upload them to Whistic by EOD tomorrow.

Next steps I propose: Ben — can you confirm the rotation cadence and paste the internal link to the rotation runbook? Marissa — FYI on the minimal slice for GreenBridge so we don't over-share.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: none

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@greenbridge.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-03-02T08:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic: service account minimal evidence ask

Thanks Stephanie — that format works. A couple clarifying points from our security reviewer:
- The reviewer prefers an exported policy snippet (JSON or screenshot) that shows the exact s3:PutObject/presign permission scope and any resource ARNs.
- If you use ephemeral presign tokens, a note about the rotation interval + tooling (e.g., Vault, KMS) is helpful.

I attached a one-line CSV template for inventories — feel free to paste the service-account row and upload.

We try to keep the Whistic profile minimal for partners (single-page evidence). If you can upload the two files (policy snippet + rotation note) to the linked Whistic profile and reply here with the link, we'll fast-track the gate.

Appreciate it,
Alex

Attachments: service_account_inventory.csv (text/csv)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@greenbridge.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Whistic: service account minimal evidence ask — upload and action items

Ben / Marissa — I uploaded the minimal snapshot to GreenBridge's Whistic profile and left an explanatory comment. Details below and copy of what I uploaded:

Uploaded artifacts (Whistic):
- service_account_inventory.csv -> row: redwood-whistic-uploader@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com | purpose: presign uploads for evidence ingestion | scope: arn:aws:s3:::greenbridge-whistic-uploads/*
- s3_presign_policy-excerpt.pdf -> screenshot of S3 bucket policy showing PutObject with resource arn and a narrow condition on prefix
- rotation-note.txt (plain text snippet pasted into Whistic) -> rotation cadence: token signing keys rotated weekly; presign tokens are 10m TTL; vault-backed signing private key in KMS with quarterly key rotation.

Ben confirmed the rotation runbook (internal link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/Token+Rotation+Runbook) and flagged that the key material is managed by customer-supplied KMS when requested (we leave the material on their side for regulated customers).

Alex — link to the Whistic profile and the attachments: https://whistic.com/profile/greenbridge-12345#evidence (I left an explicit note saying these items are the minimal subset per your intake). Please let me know if your reviewer needs anything else.

Marissa: suggest we mark this as "minimal evidence uploaded" in the onboarding tracker and close the ticket if GreenBridge confirms receipt.

Thanks team —
Stephanie
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in thread: service_account_inventory.csv, s3_presign_policy-excerpt.pdf
